Definition: neuter of compound of G3319 and G3571; midnight (especially as a watch):--midnight.
BiblicalUsage: Mesonyktion is midnight, the middle watch of the night. Acts 16:25 says at midnight Paul and Silas prayed and sang praises unto God, and the prisoners heard them, and Luke 11:5 has a man go to his friend at midnight to ask for three loaves.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe midnight is when prayer sounds loudest: prisoners heard it, and a friend at midnight still opens the door.
RelatedEvents: Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
